entities.name: SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE
entities.description: A security-protected NAS message containing integrity and confidentiality protected NAS payload.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for 5GS NAS messages.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the type of security protection applied to the NAS message.

entities.name: Spare half octet
entities.description: Reserved bits for alignment in the security header.

entities.name: Message authentication code
entities.description: Provides integrity protection for the NAS message.

entities.name: Sequence number
entities.description: Used for replay protection and sequencing of NAS messages.

entities.name: Plain 5GS NAS message
entities.description: The actual NAS message payload before security protection, with a minimum length of 2 octets for Test Mode Control messages.

relations.description: The security protected NAS message includes the extended protocol discriminator IE.
The security protected NAS message includes the security header type IE.
The security protected NAS message includes the spare half octet IE.
The security protected NAS message includes the message authentication code IE for integrity protection.
The security protected NAS message includes the sequence number IE for replay protection.
The security protected NAS message includes the plain NAS message IE as the protected payload.
The security protected NAS message requires integrity protection via the message authentication code.
